First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @riserecoverlive the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Phoenix Denver Sober Weekend Rides group ride

The Phoenix is a free sober active community. Its Denver chapter posts weekend bike rides, gravel on Saturdays and road on Sundays, open to anyone with 48 hours of sobriety. Rides are listed in the Phoenix app and events page; the Facebook page announces new routes.
